title: Compute with Python
when: testing a statement on small cases before trying to prove it, and searching for a counterexample or a witness
exact and symbolic computation: integers, rationals, polynomials, Gröbner bases, sums, limits (sympy)
searching a finite space: a SAT model (python-sat), an integer program (highspy), a graph with a property (networkx)
numerical certificates: a semidefinite program (clarabel), a high-precision constant (mpmath), whose result a Lean proof then checks
whenNot: proving the theorem: a computation is evidence, not a proof; only lean_check decides
searches that run for minutes: a call stops after 60 seconds unless you give it a timeout, at most 300, and when it stops the session's variables are lost
the network, files outside the working directory, installing packages, or plots

code.description: Python code, run in this session. The value of the last line comes back, with what the code printed

timeout.description: Seconds this call may run, 60 when not given

result_type.description: expression when the code ends with an expression, whose value is result

result.description: The value of the last expression, as Python's repr prints it

examples.title: a conjecture tested on small cases

input.code:
from sympy import isprime
[n for n in range(100) if not isprime(n*n + n + 41)]

from sympy import groebner, symbols
x, y = symbols('x y')
[str(p) for p in groebner([x**2 + y**2 - 1, x - y], x, y, order='lex').exprs]

examples.title: an object built once, then explored

input.code:
import networkx as nx
petersen = nx.petersen_graph()
print(nx.girth(petersen))
len(list(nx.find_cliques(petersen)))

examples.note: petersen stays defined for the next calls of this session, and only this session.

implementations.description: Pyodide 314.0.7 from a local copy (the setting pyodideDir), one Node process per session started with --permission (reads only Pyodide's directory and its own scratch directory, writes only the scratch directory), an empty environment, no JavaScript module for Python, no network, a WebAssembly memory cap and a time limit that ends the process.
